subject: integration
name: Boltz swaps standard (BOLTZ_NET_0_1)
summary: Defines the calls the browser's own payments make to read the fees of a Bitcoin-to-Lightning swap, create one and follow it; a site's ask is answered like an unknown code. The row names no host and makes no request. Only for a payment the person confirmed does a provider learn the invoice, the refund key and the lockup address. The definition says none of a provider's answer is trusted and the caller checks the lockup; nothing here does. Whoever answers is judged on its own row. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
